mailTest.title: Send test email
mailTest.smtpTip: Uses saved SMTP settings. Save configuration changes before testing.
mailTest.templateTip: Uses saved SMTP settings and the current template with sample comments. Sending does not save the template.
mailTest.sent: The mail server accepted the message. Check your inbox or spam folder.
mailTest.disabled: Enable and save SMTP settings first.
mailTest.rejected: The mail server rejected the sender or recipient.
mailTest.auth: SMTP authentication failed. Check the account and authorization code.
mailTest.connection: Cannot connect to SMTP. Check the host, port and TLS settings.
mailTest.failed: Sending failed. Check settings or try again later.
visits.title: Visit management
visits.description: Page views (PV), not unique visitors. Reads never increase counts. Local loopback pages are read-only.
visits.failed: Operation failed. Check the input or refresh the preview if counts changed.
visits.importTip: Upload a JSON array of {"url":"/posts/example.html","time":123}. Preview first; importing keeps the larger of the current and imported counts, so repeating an import does not add them again. Maximum 5,000 unique paths, 5 MB.
levels.colorsHint: Leave colors empty for default styles. Client settings override individual fields. Configure light and dark modes separately.
badgeColors.hint: Leave colors empty to use defaults. Client colors override these settings, field by field. Clear the label to remove it.
smtp.tip: Used for reply, site-owner, registration and password reset emails. Saved settings apply immediately. Passwords are stored only on the server and never returned.
smtp.passwordSaved: A password is configured. Leave blank to retain it, or enter a replacement.
smtp.tlsTip: When unchecked, STARTTLS is required (usually port 587). Switching back to environment settings removes these custom settings.
smtp.invalid: Could not save. Check the host, port and email addresses.
settings.imagesTip: When disabled, compatible clients hide the upload button and disable paste and drag-and-drop uploads, including custom upload functions. Refresh the comment page after saving. This controls upload tools only: manually entered image links and existing images are not blocked.
settings.imagesStorageTip: By default, images up to 128,000 bytes are stored with the comment as Base64. A client can use a custom imageUploader function for an external image host, or set imageUploader: false to disable uploads locally. Enabling this switch does not override a local disable. Private comment uploads remain disabled.
settings.registrationTip: Closing registration blocks all new accounts, including first-time social sign-ins. Existing accounts can still sign in.
settings.providerTip: Social registration also requires the registration switch. Disabling new bindings preserves existing bindings. Refresh sign-in and profile pages after saving.
settings.allowAdmin: Allow administrators to use comments while closed
settings.commentsTip: When closed, public lists and counts are empty and posting is disabled. This option lets signed-in administrators continue using the site comment area. Dashboard management remains available.
settings.failed: Could not load or save settings. Please retry.
settings.registrationClosed: Registration is currently closed. Existing users can sign in.
settings.emailClosed: Email registration is disabled. Use an enabled social sign-in method to create an account.
mail.title: Email notifications
mail.tip: Templates are saved by language and notification type. Private notifications use the corresponding template with an automatic private label in the subject and body.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.variables: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor in the last focused field. Comment content can only be inserted into the body.
mail.resetConfirm: Remove the custom template for this language and notification type?
mail.invalid: Operation failed. Check the connection and template: use only the listed variables, a single-line subject and a non-empty body.
mail.site.name: Site name
download.tip: The server uses this route for manual and scheduled updates. Third-party mirrors may be unavailable or out of date; choose a trusted source. Validation checks data structure, not official authenticity.
smtp.authorNotify: Email the author about new comments
smtp.authorNotifyTip: Send public comments (including pending moderation) to the author mailbox. Approved private comments notify the other participant, including the author, independently of this switch. All mail requires enabled SMTP.
